notes: S. 160 (Public Law 119-18) is a one-page amendment to Section 2 of the Wildfire Suppression Aircraft Transfer Act of 1996 (PL 104-307; 10 U.S.C. 2576 note). It (a) redefines the authority period to begin on enactment and end October 1, 2035 (new subsection (g)), (b) inserts 'or water' after 'fire retardant' in subsections (a)(1) and (c), and (c) rewrites subsection (b) to limit aircraft sold to 'the provision of aircraft services for wildfire suppression purposes'. Every substantive analysis claim (summary, brief, top_lines, section main/detail, underreported, gaps, changes) traces to source; no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity issue. likelihoodReason enactment/vote facts (PL 119-18, June 12 2025, UC/voice) verified against source approval line + legislative history + votes[]/sponsor metadata; stage=signed consistent, no drift. Minor non-material items: 'surplus' aircraft and 'companies that fight wildfires' are unsourced descriptors (base statute not fetched); 'drop'/'clarifies' are inferred glosses of the 'or water' insertion. Two omission rows note technical conforming amendments (1)(A) 'a period'->'the period' and (4) cross-reference (a)(1)->(g) not surfaced in prose. 0 material issues.
